characters.name: 魏收
characters.desc: A Han Chinese northern court historian around 39, narrow refined face, clear alert eyes, gently arched brows, a small neat moustache and compact pointed goatee. Dark topknot under a modest honey-brown ribbed scholar crown. Deep slate blue-grey wide-sleeved robe with warm taupe edging, white inner collar, simple white cloth waist tie. Hold one slender bamboo writing brush upright close to the chest with a compact natural hand; the other hand supports a small rolled paper at the waist. Retain the reference's observant over-shoulder character while turning torso and face enough for both eyes. Not a warrior or emperor.
